_readme: Membership/bounty links that were generated with Amazon SiteStripe (Get Link) and verified in the browser. A link on the site whose data-cta starts with membership_ must match one of these exactly (host, path and offer-selecting parameters); only the tag may vary, by page type. To add or change one: generate it with SiteStripe, check the tag survives the redirect, then edit this file in the same pull request. Do not loosen the match.

discontinued.name: Prime gift membership
discontinued.why: Amazon ended Prime gifting (SiteStripe returns PRIME_GIFT_PURCHASE_SUNSET)
